description: BTCUSDT trades of Binance spot, the first 15 minutes of 2026-10-01 (UTC), right after the bars of 2026-09, for the documentation's examples. Each is an aggregated trade: the fills of one order at one price.
encoding: Three whole numbers per trade: milliseconds since the previous trade ("from" before the first), the price minus the previous price ("basePrice" before the first) in price steps, the size in size steps.
